assumptions_warnings: Left‑ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) not available – NICE first‑line HF drugs are indicated for HFrEF (LVEF ≤ 40 %). An echocardiogram should be obtained before confirming full HF regimen.
Serum potassium not provided – required before initiating ACE‑I and MRA; assume normal but must be measured.
Liver function tests not provided – needed for safe use of statin and to rule out hepatic contraindication for SGLT2‑I.
Exact insulin dosing not provided – dose reduction of 10‑20 % is recommended when starting dapagliflozin.
Blood pressure is low (91/79 mmHg); adding further antihypertensives may cause symptomatic hypotension. Consider temporary reduction of current antihypertensives before up‑titrating ACE‑I.
No documented allergy to sulfonamides; verify before prescribing dapagliflozin.
treatment_summary: Start low‑dose ramipril, add spironolactone after potassium check, and initiate dapagliflozin with insulin dose reduction to provide guideline‑recommended disease‑modifying therapy for HFrEF while monitoring renal function, electrolytes, blood pressure, and hypoglycaemia. Continue existing antihypertensives, statin, tacrolimus, and insulin, adjusting antihypertensive regimen as needed to avoid hypotension. Avoid NSAIDs, verapamil, diltiazem, and thiazolidinediones. Obtain missing investigations (LVEF, serum K+, LFTs) before full titration.
